snippet.title: Ballseye - Official Gameplay Trailer - DEMO IS OUT!
snippet.description:
Announcing Ballseye Demo Release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5247220/Ballseye/

This version contains:

Controller Support!
MacOS Support!
Steam Deck Support!
Linux Support!
Full Screen Options!

A 2D Shooter inspired by Nubby's Number Factory's Aesthetic.

You get to build your own levels, you get to play them solo or with anyone online with the game! You can go for a default campaign.

There are 26+ unique balls to play with, you get to modify them and upgrade them to get very powerful.

There are up to 8 Areas so far and they are provided based on difficulty and everything about them is seeded and procedurally generated! So no 2 levels are the same.

Destroying every enemy in a level gets you into the Ballmart, a wonderful place where balls can be bought from or upgraded in your inventory!

You can play versus other players in multiplayer, system is similar to Noita's Entangled Worlds, relying on steam for connection.

The trailer music was made by Horscht! Thank You For Everything.

Enjoy!
